My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
If the tracking indicates delivered but you did not receive the package, the following steps are recommended:
Check around the delivery location Inspect entrances, side doors, porches, mailrooms, parcel lockers, or with building reception.
Ask neighbors or others in your household Carriers may leave packages with a neighbor or another individual at the address.
Allow a little extra time Occasionally, carriers mark a package as delivered shortly before it actually arrives.
If the package still does not appear, contact us for assistance The available support options are:
Email: info@nanuk.com
Phone: 1-800-783-6883
